nodes.title: SG-2.7 Track game/public/assets/ui icons, frames and cursors with manifest entries
nodes.body:
Context: game/public/assets/worlds/the-boys-room/manifest.json already lists ui:icon-sound, ui:panel-frame and ui:cursor-pointer under ui/icons, ui/frames and ui/cursors. game/public/assets has no ui folder. The SVGs exist only under game/frontend/public/assets/ui. Desired behavior: each of the three folders under game/public/assets/ui holds one real pixel-art SVG tracked by git, and the manifest entries describe those files. Expected result: the folders are tracked and the manifest resolves to them. Why: git does not track empty folders, and the manifest should describe files that exist next to it.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the repo, When game/public/assets/ui/icons, frames and cursors are listed, Then each contains at least one non-empty .svg file
- Given manifest.json, When ui:icon-sound, ui:panel-frame and ui:cursor-pointer paths are resolved under game/public/assets, Then every file exists
- Given the manifest ui entries, When validated with parseManifest, Then validation succeeds and each dimensions value equals the width and height of its SVG


## Scope
- In scope: Three new SVG files under game/public/assets/ui
- In scope: dimensions fields on the three ui manifest entries
- Out of scope: Changing the zod schema
- Out of scope: Phaser or React code
- Out of scope: Removing game/frontend/public/assets/ui
- Preserve: Existing manifest entries, ids and paths
- Preserve: Existing tests under game/tests


## Technical constraints
- SVGs must use shape-rendering="crispEdges" like the existing assets
- Manifest must still pass manifestSchema in game/src/assets/manifest/schema.ts


## Definition of done
- All requirements are met and their Verify units pass


## Non-functional requirements
- Pixel-art-friendly rendering


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Each ui folder holds a real tracked SVG under game/public/assets/ui
nodes.body:
Context: game/public/assets/ui does not exist. Desired behavior: sound.svg, panel-frame.svg and pointer.svg are added under the matching folders, with the same content as game/frontend/public/assets/ui. Expected result: git tracks all three folders. Why: SG-2.7 requires real files so the folders are tracked.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given game/public/assets/ui/icons, When listed, Then sound.svg exists and is non-empty
- Given game/public/assets/ui/frames and cursors, When listed, Then panel-frame.svg and pointer.svg exist and are non-empty
- Given each of the three SVGs, When read, Then it has an <svg root, width and height attributes and shape-rendering="crispEdges"


## Scope
- In scope: game/public/assets/ui/icons/sound.svg
- In scope: game/public/assets/ui/frames/panel-frame.svg
- In scope: game/public/assets/ui/cursors/pointer.svg
- Out of scope: Other asset folders
- Preserve: game/frontend/public/assets/ui files


## Technical constraints
- Reuse the existing SVG content; do not invent new art


## Definition of done
- Three SVG files exist and are tracked


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Manifest ui entries carry dimensions that match the SVG files
nodes.body:
Context: the three ui manifest entries have id, path and type but no dimensions, and the asset manifest requires dimensions for the asset records. Desired behavior: add dimensions 16x16, 24x24 and 16x16 matching the SVG width and height attributes. Expected result: the manifest still validates and every ui path resolves. Why: SG-2.7 asks for matching manifest entries.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given manifest.json, When parsed with parseManifest, Then ok is true
- Given the ui:icon-sound entry, When read, Then dimensions is {width:16,height:16}; ui:panel-frame is {24,24}; ui:cursor-pointer is {16,16}
- Given each ui entry path, When resolved under game/public/assets, Then the file exists and its SVG width and height equal the entry dimensions


## Scope
- In scope: The three ui entries in manifest.json
- Out of scope: Non-ui entries
- Preserve: ids and paths of all entries


## Technical constraints
- dimensions must be positive integers per dimensionsSchema


## Dependencies
- REQ1


## Definition of done
- Manifest ui entries have correct dimensions


## Clarifying questions
- None
